taxon.note: Scientific and common names (and USDA symbol, where given) as the spec's authors wrote them, and the genus the scientific name is written in.

growth_form.note: The growth form the spec's authors chose from the plant's habit.

growth.note: The growth plan (years, step, keyframes) chosen for growing and rendering, not a botanical fact.

variants.note: The environments, conditions and seeds chosen for growing and rendering, not a botanical fact.

taxon.family.note: WCVP v16's family for the accepted name.

taxon.plant_name_id.note: WCVP v16's plant_name_id for the accepted species the name resolves to (the accepted name).

traits.height_typical_m.note: Flora of North America vol. 9 (2014), Rosa rugosa (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): stems erect, sometimes arching, 10-25 dm; Flora of China: to 2 m.

traits.height_max_m.note: Flora of North America vol. 9 (2014), Rosa rugosa (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): stems to 25 dm.

traits.stem_clump.note: Flora of North America vol. 9 (2014), Rosa rugosa (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): shrubs forming thickets.

traits.stem_hairs.note: Flora of North America vol. 9 (2014), Rosa rugosa (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): young stems densely tomentose or puberulent.

traits.spine_length_m.note: Flora of North America vol. 9 (2014), Rosa rugosa (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): prickles paired below the stipules, erect, stout, about 10 mm, dense, mixed with bristles; Flora of China: to 5 mm.

traits.bark_colour.note: Flora of North America vol. 9 (2014), Rosa rugosa (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): bark greenish white when young, purplish black with age; drawn a greyed purple-brown between them; sRGB by eye.

traits.leaf_colour.note: Flora of North America vol. 9 (2014), Rosa rugosa (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): leaflets dark green and lustrous above, rugose; sRGB by eye for the words.

traits.leaf_length_m.note: Flora of North America vol. 9 (2014), Rosa rugosa (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): leaves 7-11 cm; Flora of China 5-13 cm with the petiole.

traits.leaflets.note: Flora of North America vol. 9 (2014), Rosa rugosa (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): leaflets 5-9.

traits.leaflet_length_m.note: Flora of North America vol. 9 (2014), Rosa rugosa (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): terminal leaflet blade 20-55 mm long; Flora of China 1.5-4.5 cm.

traits.leaflet_width_m.note: Flora of North America vol. 9 (2014), Rosa rugosa (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): terminal leaflet blade 10-35 mm wide.

traits.leaf_shape.note: Flora of North America vol. 9 (2014), Rosa rugosa (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): leaflet blades widely elliptic to ovate, rarely obovate, leathery.

traits.leaf_apex.note: Flora of North America vol. 9 (2014), Rosa rugosa (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): leaflet apex obtuse to acute.

traits.leaf_margin.note: Flora of North America vol. 9 (2014), Rosa rugosa (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): leaflet margins crenate-serrate, 11-17 teeth a side.

traits.leaf_hairs_beneath.note: Flora of China vol. 9 (2003), Rosa rugosa (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): leaflets tomentose and net-veined beneath.

traits.inflorescence.note: Flora of China vol. 9 (2003), Rosa rugosa (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): flowers solitary, or several clustered; FNA: corymbs of 1 (to 4).

traits.pedicel_length_m.note: Flora of North America vol. 9 (2014), Rosa rugosa (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): pedicels stout, 10-15 (to 30) mm; Flora of China 5-25 mm.

traits.flower_size_m.note: Flora of North America vol. 9 (2014), Rosa rugosa (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): flowers 6-9 cm across; Flora of China 4-5.5 cm.

traits.petal_length_m.note: Flora of North America vol. 9 (2014), Rosa rugosa (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): petals 35-50 mm.

traits.sepal_length_m.note: Flora of North America vol. 9 (2014), Rosa rugosa (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): sepals erect, ovate-lanceolate, 20-37 mm.

traits.sepal_posture.note: Flora of North America vol. 9 (2014), Rosa rugosa (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): sepals erect.

traits.flower_colour.note: Flora of North America vol. 9 (2014), Rosa rugosa (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): petals purplish pink or white; sRGB by eye for purplish pink.

traits.carpels.note: Flora of North America vol. 9 (2014), Rosa rugosa (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): carpels 48-60.

traits.fruit_size_m.note: Flora of North America vol. 9 (2014), Rosa rugosa (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): hips 18-20 mm long.

traits.fruit_width_m.note: Flora of North America vol. 9 (2014), Rosa rugosa (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): hips 20-25 mm wide; Flora of China 2-2.5 cm across.

traits.fruit_shape.note: Flora of North America vol. 9 (2014), Rosa rugosa (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): hips depressed-globose.

traits.fruit_colour_ripe.note: Flora of North America vol. 9 (2014), Rosa rugosa (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): hips scarlet; sRGB by eye for the word.

traits.calyx_in_fruit.note: Flora of North America vol. 9 (2014), Rosa rugosa (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): sepals persistent and erect on the hip.

traits.flowering_months.note: Flora of China vol. 9 (2003), Rosa rugosa (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): flowering May to June; FNA June to July (to October).

traits.fruiting_months.note: Flora of China vol. 9 (2003), Rosa rugosa (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): fruiting August to September; hips held into October.

appearance.note: Every look comes from the characters through the library's rules: a dense thicket of bristly prickly stems with dark glossy wrinkled leaves, large purplish-pink single roses and big flattened scarlet hips with erect sepals.

allometry.note: 2.0 m tall at 12 years in the open, inside the floras' range of heights, as grown. Replace with measured data before calling this species calibrated.
